text:
sophia-sales: Quick sync — AcmeBank POC wants confirmation on multi-AZ keystore compatibility + HSM proxy latency for BYO-HSM. Also asking if key rotation windows and attestation docs can be included in SOW. Any blockers?

alan-crypto: Do they mean full BYO-HSM (customer HSM in their VPC) with our proxy, or using our Dedicated HSM fleet? Important for latency and attestation.

sophia-sales: They said BYO-HSM in their Azure region, immediate POC, want <50ms p95 if possible. They also want us to fill a security questionnaire about FIPS / key lifecycle.

maria-ops: @sophia-sales ok — BYO-proxy path is supported. Network notes: need outbound TLS to our proxy IPs, we require mTLS using client certs. Latency: expect added 10–35ms for cross-AZ. If they co-locate in same AZ -> about 5–12ms overhead.

alan-crypto: For attestation: we can provide HSM vendor attestation docs + key origin statement. Rotation: we support customer-triggered rotation and automated rotation with configurable TTL. Note: we never persist plaintext KEKs outside the HSM.

maria-ops: Also need firewall rule: 52.24.11.98/32 outbound (or our customer-specific proxy IPs) and port 443. For POC we can white-list a single IP to simplify.

sophia-sales: Pricing question from buyer: is there a surcharge for BYO-HSM proxy egress or a per-device monthly fee?

alan-crypto: POC-friendly approach — waive per-device fee for 30d trial. Post-POC, standard is flat proxy endpoint fee + small per-request markup. Looping finance. cc @elaine-fp

elaine-fp: Confirming — standard enterprise setup: $1,000/mo per proxy endpoint + $0.005 per 1k requests. We can discount on committed volumes in SOW. :moneybag:

sophia-sales: Thanks. Can someone paste the minimal config snippet the customer needs so they can test? They want it asap.

maria-ops: paste
```
# sample client config (kex + proxy)
keystore:
  backend: hsm-proxy
  endpoint: https://proxy.redwood-inference.example
  mTLS:
    cert_path: /etc/keys/client.crt
    key_path: /etc/keys/client.key
  ca: /etc/keys/ca.pem
```

alan-crypto: Also add this curl test for attestation
```
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key https://proxy.redwood-inference.example/attest
```

sophia-sales: I'll send to customer and update the questionnaire. Any enterprise blockers left? compliance/legal?

elaine-fp: Legal asks: provide ATO timeline and insurance coverage level. Security might request a pen-test report on their HSM environment (optional for POC, required for production).

kmseval-eng: For perf validation, run RL bench on their endpoints with a 128-token sequence and KV caching disabled to simulate cold starts. Share perf logs to #eng-ml and we’ll validate p95 targets.

sophia-sales: Great — I'll own coordination. Next steps: send config + attestation docs + draft SOW addendum, confirm firewall IPs, and schedule perf window. Thanks all :thumbsup:
